hypothesis: On forward 30m STRAT_212_CONTINUATION episodes that pass the unchanged floor_ge1r activation rule, the frozen first-sight underlying path has a describable R distribution. This draft does not claim that distribution is an edge.

baseline.label: main at draft registration; #1114 did not change the closed options experiment

candidate.change: Measure the existing floor_ge1r first-sight underlying path once, after the forward stopping rule, without a second target variant or an option fill model.
candidate.label: floor_ge1r first-sight underlying outcome — measurement contract only

data.source: FORWARD col-v0.1 / cov-v0.1 / ep-v0.1 / out-v0.1 coverage collection; no retrospective file is an input

window.end: stop at 25 floor_ge1r activations or 60 NYSE sessions, whichever comes first

population: Options 30m STRAT_212_CONTINUATION; exact 20-symbol V1 universe [AAPL, AMZN, BAC, COIN, GE, GOOGL, INTC, IWM, JPM, MRK, MSFT, NFLX, NVDA, PLTR, QQQ, SPY, TLT, TSLA, WMT, XOM]; forward NYSE sessions from 2026-10-05 inclusive until 25 floor_ge1r activations or 60 sessions, whichever comes first; sessions through 2026-10-02 inclusive are ineligible
held_constant: activation gate_bucket_floor WOULD_OTHERWISE_QUALIFY at first sight
stored entry_trigger is structural context and is never the measured fill
cov-v0.1 / ep-v0.1 / out-v0.1 identity, with the preregistered gap rules controlling fills
blind readout is sessions elapsed and cumulative activation count only
no nearest_v1 comparison and no additional target variant
no option contract, premium, or dollar P&L model
no watchlist, SPXW, risk, or execution change

execution.entry_logic: measured_entry_price = first_sight_price. The stored Strat entry_trigger is structural setup context only and must not be substituted as the fill. Activation means gate_bucket_floor == WOULD_OTHERWISE_QUALIFY at first sight. Activation is not permission to choose a retrospectively better fill.
execution.exit_logic: Same regular session only. TARGET_FIRST uses floor target_1_r, never an open beyond the target. INVALIDATION_FIRST uses the open's R when the bar opens beyond the stop, otherwise the invalidation's R versus measured_entry_price. A bar that reaches both stop and Target 1 is AMBIGUOUS and is excluded. Timeout is UNRESOLVED_AT_CLOSE at close_r versus measured_entry_price. DATA_INVALID is excluded. No trailing exit and no Target 2 exit.
execution.stop_logic: Stored invalidation. If the 5-minute bar opens beyond the stop and does not reach Target 1, INVALIDATION_FIRST at the R of that open versus measured_entry_price; the stop price inside the gap is not a fill. If the bar reaches both the stop and Target 1, including a gap that spans both, AMBIGUOUS with flag gap_or_range_spans_stop_and_target. A non-gap touch of the stop uses the invalidation price. Missing 5-minute bars fail closed as DATA_INVALID.
execution.target_logic: Unchanged floor_ge1r target_1. If the bar opens beyond Target 1 and does not reach the stop, TARGET_FIRST at target_1_r; the open beyond Target 1 is not a fill. If that open is also beyond Target 2, record Target 2 as reached and still use target_1_r. Target 2 is not an exit. A gap through Target 2 that also reaches the stop is AMBIGUOUS.
execution.sizing: None. One underlying R per completed activation. No portfolio, overlap, or drawdown model.
execution.friction: No dollar P&L and no added slippage. R uses structural risk as the denominator and the first-sight price as the entry. Stage B option fills are NOT EVALUATED.

notes: DRAFT registration only. Not collection and not scoring. measured_entry_price = first_sight_price. Before the one look the only visible study fields are NYSE sessions elapsed and the cumulative floor_ge1r activation count. Acceptance and rejection criteria are null. Written results are INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE below 15 completed outcomes and DESCRIPTIVE MEASUREMENT at 15 or more. This is forward Stage A descriptive evidence, not a confirmatory edge test. Stage B is NOT EVALUATED. No drawdown. Do not start this trial's collection until this registration is on main. The closed 59-episode trial stays closed.
